welcomeBody: Sign in with your organization account to access monthly reporting.
signInHint: Use the email address and password provided to you.
privacyNote: Your sign-in details are protected by secure access controls.
overviewAdminHint: Here is an overview of your organization's reports and setup.
headOverviewHint: Review pending reports from your assigned departments and track feedback.
secretaryOverviewHint: Review reports sent to you and move them to the next review stage.
viceOverviewHint: Review reports at your stage, then forward them to the chairperson or return them with feedback.
chairOverviewHint: Complete the final report review and approve, return, or reject each report.
quickReportsHint: View reports and their review progress.
quickNewReportHint: Start a report for the current period.
quickCreateAccountHint: Add a user and assign their system role.
quickAddDepartmentHint: Register a department for reporting and membership.
quickAssignmentHint: Assign a department head, assistant, or member.
periodsPageHint: Open a reporting period and track the dates and status of existing periods.
organizationPageHint: Manage accounts, departments, and team role assignments.
headReportsHint: Review submitted reports from your assigned departments, then return or forward them to the secretary.
secretaryReportsHint: Review reports in your secretary queue.
viceReportsHint: Review reports in your vice chairperson queue.
chairReportsHint: Complete the final review and decision for reports.
reviewReportsHint: Review submitted reports and record your decision.
memberReportsHint: View report progress for departments you belong to.
viewReportsHint: View organization reports and reporting progress.
searchReports: Search by department, period, or content
adjustFilters: Try changing your search or selected status.
noPeriods: No reporting periods have been created yet.
noAccounts: No accounts have been created yet.
noDepartments: No departments have been created yet.
setupHeadAssignment: A department head is assigned to a department
setupMemberAssignment: A member is assigned to a department
confirmClosePeriod: Are you sure? Closing the period prevents drafts from being edited or submitted.
confirmDeactivateAccount: Are you sure you want to deactivate this account?
confirmDeactivateDepartment: Are you sure you want to deactivate this department?
confirmRemoveMember: Remove this member from the department?
noOpenPeriod: There is no open reporting period.
reportForwarded: Report forwarded to the next review stage.
noReportHistory: No review actions have been recorded yet.
notification_report_submitted: A new report was submitted and is awaiting review.
notification_report_department_forward: A report was forwarded to the secretary.
notification_report_department_return: A department head returned a report.
notification_report_secretary_forward: A report was forwarded to the vice chairperson.
notification_report_vice_forward: A report was forwarded to the chairperson.
notification_report_vice_return: The vice chairperson returned a report.
notification_report_vice_reject: The vice chairperson rejected a report.
notification_deadline_reminder: The reporting period closes within three days. Complete and submit your report.
error_report_already_exists: A report for this department and period already exists.
error_reporting_period_already_exists: A reporting period for that year and month already exists.
error_reporting_period_closed: The reporting period is closed or not currently open.
error_report_incomplete: Complete every report field before submitting.
error_review_comment_required: Add a comment before returning a report.
error_email_already_registered: This email address is already registered.
error_department_already_exists: A department with this name already exists.
error_cannot_deactivate_own_account: You cannot deactivate your own account.
error_cannot_remove_last_admin: At least one active administrator account must remain.
error_cannot_deactivate_last_admin: At least one active administrator account must remain.
error_report_not_reviewable: This report cannot be reviewed right now.
error_invalid_department_assignment: A department head assignment requires a department head account role.
error_invalid_reporting_dates: The closing date cannot be before the opening date.
error_forbidden: You are not allowed to perform this action.
noReportsHint: Reports appear here according to your account permissions.
error_invalid_credentials: The email address or password is incorrect.
error_password_must_be_different: Choose a new password different from the current one.
error_validation_failed: Please check the information you entered.
error_too_many_login_attempts: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
error_internal_server_error: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
error_network: Could not reach the server. Check that it is running.
passwordChangeHint: Confirm your current password and choose a new one with at least 8 characters.
passwordConfirmationMismatch: The new password and confirmation do not match.
passwordChangedSignInAgain: Password changed. Sign in again with your new password.
